newsitem.title: USA: Rival posts Q3 March 31 loss after charge.
newsitem.headline: Rival posts Q3 March 31 loss after charge.

text.p: Rival Co said a charge taken after the closing of a facility in Montreal and a decline in gross margins were among the factors behind a loss in the third quarter ended March 31.
The company said it lost $4.3 million, or $0.44 a share, compared to net income of $1.6 million, or $0.16, in the same period a year ago. Sales rose to $74.8 million from $61.9 million, Rival said.

Rival said it took a $3.0 million charge related to the closing of the manufacturing, distribution and administrative facility in Montreal. Other factors affecting third-quarter results included high inventories, excess plant capacity and low seasonal production levels, the company said.
Rival makes household appliances, personal care products, fans and pumps.
Its shares were off 6-1/8 Friday at 15-1/4.
